scope: Model/editor semantic and pedagogy review of Lesson 0132; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: ‘Yes. The pay is good.’ and ‘The pay is good there too.’ are grammatical, natural uses of pay as a noun meaning remuneration.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian copy consistently maps noun pay to «حقوق» and explicitly distinguishes it from the verb meaning ‘پرداخت کردن’.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: One lexical noun sense is recognized, practiced in dialogue, checked in listening/meaning tasks, transferred to a second workplace, and retrieved with the answer hidden.

distractorQuality.evidence: Distractors contrast noun pay with unrelated nouns and the verb gloss without duplicating the correct answer.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: مایا و الکس در مرکز آموزشی درباره دو کار پاره‌وقت روی تابلو اعلانات حرف می‌زنند.

difficultyFit.evidence: The work/pay topic is accessible through short copular sentences and one scored lexical target.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: pay recurs across recognition, guided speech, listening, transfer, and hidden retrieval.

transferQuality.evidence: The learner evaluates pay in a second workplace while preserving the same remuneration noun sense.

overallCoherence.evidence: Outcome, scenario, target construction, learner turns, and final retrieval all align to the noun sense of pay.

learnerExperience.evidence: No real learner test is claimed; perceived relevance and difficulty remain unverified.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
Only the bounded noun sense of pay meaning remuneration is reviewed.
Generated audio pronunciation/prosody is not evaluated at this text stage.
resolvedFindings: English grammar, noun/verb sense consistency, and accepted speech strings were checked.
Persian orthography and English–Persian meaning consistency were checked.
Reference key, part of speech, sense key, and provisional spec hash were cross-checked against the worker packet.
Final retrieval keeps the answer hidden before attempt.
